title: Natural linewidth
caption: A state that lives τ = 16 ns cannot have a perfectly sharp energy: the line has a Lorentzian shape with full width at half maximum Δν = 1/(2πτ) = 9.9 MHz. Shorter-lived states give broader lines.
alt: A Lorentzian line shape centred on the transition frequency, with its full width at half maximum of about 10 megahertz marked.
description: Horizontal axis: detuning from the line centre in MHz.
Lifetime τ = 16 ns: Δν = 1 / (2π × 16 × 10⁻⁹ s) = 9.95 MHz.
The intensity falls to half at ±Δν/2 from the centre.
